en.description:
Discover Chaozhou gongfu tea through a hands-on game for Apple Watch. Prepare a brew, share it among three small cups, and explore the stories behind the tradition.

Remember the target tea color, arrange your cups, and draw a pouring route. Choose your leaves and water, watch the brew deepen, then turn the Digital Crown to guide the pour. Can you share the tea evenly while matching the target?

• Brew and pour with touch and the Digital Crown.
• Balance tea color, cup levels, and the amount you spill.
• Discover short “Did you know?” stories about Chaozhou tea culture, its utensils, and everyday customs.
• Pick up your current round with progress saved locally.
• Play offline, directly on Apple Watch. No iPhone companion app or account is required.

Created to share an appreciation of Chaozhou gongfu tea through play. The game draws inspiration from the tradition and simplifies brewing into a playful challenge.

Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 11 or later. The game is in English.
en.subtitle: Explore Chaozhou Tea Culture
